design_notes.purpose: Test ridge universality across ω/κ_phase ratio.
design_notes.hypothesis_A: κ_C peak stable at ~0.27 across ratios (universal ridge).
design_notes.hypothesis_B: κ_C peak shifts LOWER at ratio 0.2 (phase-locked regime).
design_notes.hypothesis_C: κ_C peak shifts HIGHER at ratio 0.2.
design_notes.recycle_source: S105 r02_k030 (κ_C=0.15) — 8 seeds × 50 chunks, identical protocol.
